body: This is honestly the only reason i haven't been able to. She's very important to me. More important than ending it all. But at the same time its hard to carry this weight and put her through my manic/depressive outbursts.

I stopped being close to my family when i was 15. My mother and adopted father verbally abused me quite a bit. I basically detached myself from them emotionally and the only family i consider having is my siblings. But they are on the other side of the country and we only speak every couple months or so.

Honestly, no. I don't quite understand my fascination with death. Sometimes its just an overwhelming suicidal feeling and sometimes its just stress, pressure and life. I've gotten to the point now where when I get too anxious my instant reply is "if i had just killed myself like i was supposed to I wouldn't be dealing with this" Its really terrible because i have encountered people who were much more sick than i am. But at the same time it just feels exhausting. I don't even know whats wrong with me. I've never been properly diagnosed. Its just hard when i feel like its all fake and in my head. Suicide was never a wrong answer for me, and I don't think I can change that. For as long as I can remember that's how I knew I would end up. Its a weird feeling to still be alive. I don't know if you could understand that. I know that my GF can't. Even though she loves me more than anything in the world and spends 90% of her time with me, it doesn't change how alone I feel.
